newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS FOURTH DAY OF SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN DELAYS FOURTH DAY OF SECOND TEST.

text.p: Thunder, lightning and torrential rain delayed the start of the fourth day's play in the second test between England and Australia at Lord's on Sunday.

Twenty minutes after the scheduled 11 a.m. (1000GMT) start, the sun began to shine and the umpires decided to schedule lunch half an hour early at 12.30 (1130GMT) and inspect the pitch after the 40-minute break.
Rain washed out Thursday's opening day and only 92 minutes' play were possible on Friday.
Australia, one down in the six-test Ashes series, were 131 for two in reply to England's 77.
